title: Spring Data JPA: entities, relationships, queries and projections

videos.script: In lesson 10 you wrote the repositories by hand. A class each, an EntityManager, and a JPQL string for every question the shop asked. {{handwritten}} Most of that code says the same few things. Find this book. Count the books. Save this one. {{same}} Spring Data JPA writes that class for you. You declare an interface, and when the application starts, an implementation exists. {{interface}} Even the queries can come from the method's name. findByTitleContainingIgnoreCase is a method and a query at once. {{names}} That is convenient, and convenience hides things. So every method in this lesson is read twice: once in Java, and once as the SQL it really sends. {{sql}} You will see a misspelt name stop the application before it serves anybody. You will see the N+1 problem come back, and one annotation send it away. {{failures}} And you will page through the catalogue two books at a time, and count the queries each page costs. {{paging}}
